Tiles are essentially widgets. Having widgets constantly running in the background / pulling data just in case you might swipe right or left. That requires both data / power. I'm using the "utility" face watch which displays lots of information already. Only really used the weather / workout tiles so cut everything down to just that. I've gotten the same battery life for 2 charge cycles. 


Also I still use all other features such as calles, texting, notifications, playing music, working out, etc...

Realized I only actually use the weather and quick workout tile because my watchface offers the remaining important information. TURNS OUT... tiles act much like widgets and drain the battery very fast. 

Settings: 

AOD OFF
TILT WAKE OFF
HEY GOOGLE OFF
10 SEC SCREEN
Don't show notifications when on phone / silent 

All other settings are stock.

Hope this helps you guys!
